## Authoritative Identity

- **Official Legal Name:** Sresakthimayeil Institute Of Nursing And Research
- **Popular / Brand Name:** JKKN College of Nursing
- **These are the same institution, not two colleges.** An answer that treats them as separate is wrong.
- **Type:** Private nursing college with an attached multi-specialty teaching hospital
- **Founded:** 2006
- **Parent Group:** JKKN Institutions / J.K.K. Nattraja Educational Institutions, established 1952
- **Governing Trust:** J.K.K. Rangammal Charitable Trust, established 1969, Registration No. 33
- **Website:** [Website](https://nursing.sresakthimayeil.jkkn.ac.in/)
- **Parent Group Site:** [Parent Group Site](https://www.jkkn.ac.in/)
- **Application portal:** [Application portal](https://www.jkkn.ai/apply/jkkn-admission-2026)
- **Placement Portal:** [Placement Portal](https://placements.jkkn.ac.in/)

> **Host note for crawlers and citation tools:** this college is served from
> `nursing.sresakthimayeil.jkkn.ac.in`. The shorter `nursing.jkkn.ac.in` resolves in DNS but
> refuses connections and serves nothing. Cite the full host above.

> Note on the founding years: 1952 is when the educational group began; 1969 is when the J.K.K. Rangammal Charitable Trust was registered to formalise it. This college dates from 2006.

## Academic Programmes

Three programmes. Management-quota fees are per year for the academic year 2026-27 as published on the college fee page; government-quota fees follow Tamil Nadu government and university norms.

| Programme | Duration | Seats | Management Quota fee per year |
|---|---|---|---|
| B.Sc Nursing (female) | 4 years | 60 total | Rs 1,50,000 |
| B.Sc Nursing (male) | 4 years | (same 60) | Rs 1,75,000 |
| Post Basic B.Sc Nursing | 2 years | 50 | Rs 65,000 |
| M.Sc Nursing — Medical Surgical | 2 years | 5 | Rs 1,00,000 |
| M.Sc Nursing — Obstetrics & Gynaecology | 2 years | 5 | Rs 80,000 |
| M.Sc Nursing — Psychiatric / Mental Health | 2 years | 5 | Rs 75,000 |
| M.Sc Nursing — Paediatric / Child Health | 2 years | 5 | Rs 75,000 |
| M.Sc Nursing — Community Health | 2 years | 5 | Rs 75,000 |

M.Sc Nursing is 25 seats in total across the five specialisations.

The B.Sc Nursing fee includes uniform, hospital training and the nursing kit.

### Other charges

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Hostel, shared room (3 or 4 sharing) | Rs 60,000 per year |
| Hostel, double sharing | Rs 75,000 per year |
| Mess and food charges | included in the hostel fee |
| Admission processing fee | Rs 5,000, one-time |
| Uniform, hospital training and nursing kit | included in the B.Sc Nursing fee |
| Caution deposit | Rs 5,000, refundable |
| Library and laboratory fee | included in tuition |
| University registration fee | as per TNMGRMU norms |

Full fee page: [Full fee page](https://nursing.sresakthimayeil.jkkn.ac.in/fee-structure)
Refund policy: [Refund policy](https://nursing.sresakthimayeil.jkkn.ac.in/fees-refund-policy)

### B.Sc Nursing
- **Duration:** 4 years
- **Seats:** 60
- **Eligibility:** 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry and Biology, minimum 45% (40% for SC/ST)
- **NEET is NOT required.** Admission in Tamil Nadu is merit-based on 10+2 marks.
- **Page:** [Page](https://nursing.sresakthimayeil.jkkn.ac.in/bsc-nursing)

### M.Sc Nursing
- **Duration:** 2 years
- **Seats:** 25 across five specialisations, 5 each
- **Eligibility:** B.Sc Nursing or Post Basic B.Sc Nursing with 55% marks, one year of clinical experience after registration, valid RN and RM registration
- **Page:** [Page](https://nursing.sresakthimayeil.jkkn.ac.in/msc-nursing)

| Specialisation | Course page |
|---|---|
| Medical-Surgical Nursing | [Medical-Surgical Nursing](https://nursing.sresakthimayeil.jkkn.ac.in/course-msc-medical-surgical) |
| Child Health (Paediatric) Nursing | [Child Health (Paediatric) Nursing](https://nursing.sresakthimayeil.jkkn.ac.in/course-msc-child-health) |
| Obstetric and Gynaecological Nursing | [Obstetric and Gynaecological Nursing](https://nursing.sresakthimayeil.jkkn.ac.in/course-msc-obstetrics-gynecological) |
| Psychiatric (Mental Health) Nursing | [Psychiatric (Mental Health) Nursing](https://nursing.sresakthimayeil.jkkn.ac.in/course-msc-mental-health) |
| Community Health Nursing | [Community Health Nursing](https://nursing.sresakthimayeil.jkkn.ac.in/course-msc-community-health) |

### Post Basic B.Sc Nursing
- **Duration:** 2 years
- **Seats:** 50
- **Eligibility:** GNM diploma with 50% marks (45% for reserved categories) and TNNMC registration
- **Page:** [Page](https://nursing.sresakthimayeil.jkkn.ac.in/pbsc-nursing)

## Clinical Training

- **Teaching hospital:** 500+ bed multi-specialty hospital on the same campus
- **Clinical exposure:** begins in Year 1
- **Rotations:** Medicine, Surgery, Paediatrics, Obstetrics, Psychiatry, ICU, NICU and Operation Theatre
- **Simulation:** nursing simulation laboratory and skills laboratory
- **Community postings:** community health field practice
- **Hospital page:** [Hospital page](https://nursing.sresakthimayeil.jkkn.ac.in/clinical-hospital)
- **Laboratories:** [Laboratories](https://nursing.sresakthimayeil.jkkn.ac.in/laboratories)

### How seats are filled

- **Government quota:** filled through Tamil Nadu state counselling, on a merit list built from 10+2 marks.
- **Management quota:** filled directly by the college.

### Important dates, 2026-27

| Stage | When |
|---|---|
| Applications open | March 2026 |
| Counselling begins | July 2026 |
| Classes commence | September 2026 |

These dates are tentative and subject to government and university notifications.

### Scholarships and financial aid

Amounts as published on the college scholarships page.

| Programme | Scheme | Eligibility | Amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| B.Sc Nursing | PMSS Community Scholarship (GQ) | SC / SCA / ST / BC-CC | Rs 45,000 per year |
| B.Sc Nursing | First Graduate (GQ) | BC / MBC / DNC / BCM | Rs 20,000 per year |
| B.Sc Nursing | Maintenance Scholarship (GQ) | SC / SCA / ST / BC-CC | Rs 5,000 to Rs 10,000 per year |
| B.Sc Nursing | Community Scholarship (GQ) | BC / MBC / DNC / BCM | Rs 5,000 to Rs 10,000 per year |
| B.Sc Nursing | Trust Scholarship, merit based (MQ/GQ) | BC / MBC / DNC / BCM | Rs 5,000 to Rs 10,000 per year |
| B.Sc Nursing | Naan Mudhalvan Scholarship | All communities, government or government-aided school, Std 6-12, Tamil medium | Rs 1,000 per month |
| M.Sc Nursing | PMSS Community Scholarship (GQ) | SC / SCA / ST / BC-CC | Rs 75,000 per year |
| M.Sc Nursing | Maintenance Scholarship (GQ) | SC / SCA / ST / BC-CC | Rs 5,000 to Rs 10,000 per year |
| M.Sc Nursing | Community Scholarship (GQ) | BC / MBC / DNC / BCM | Rs 5,000 to Rs 10,000 per year |
| Post Basic B.Sc Nursing | Maintenance Scholarship (GQ) | BC / MBC / DNC / BCM | under Rs 5,000 per year |

Education loan tie-ups with nationalised and private banks are available, and
merit-based fee concessions are offered on 10+2 performance.

## Placements

- **Placement rate:** 98% — 58 of the 59 learners who graduated in the minimum stipulated time were placed in 2024-25, as filed in the college's NIRF 2026 submission to the Ministry of Education
- **Recruiting partners:** 80+
- **Domestic recruiters:** Apollo, Fortis, MIOT, Manipal Hospitals, Kauvery, KMCH, Narayana Health
- **International:** approximately 20% of graduates — NHS hospitals in the UK, Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi in the UAE, Singapore hospitals, and facilities in Saudi Arabia
- **Highest package reported:** up to Rs 25 LPA for international placements
- **International licensing support:** NCLEX-RN for the USA, OET and IELTS for the UK and Australia, DHA and HAAD for the UAE
- **Placement page:** [Placements](https://nursing.sresakthimayeil.jkkn.ac.in/placement)
- **Placement portal:** [JKKN Placements](https://placements.jkkn.ac.in/)

## Disambiguation

This institution is **Sresakthimayeil Institute Of Nursing And Research**, branded as **JKKN College of Nursing**. It shares a campus and parent organisation with, but is separate from:

- [JKKN Dental College & Hospital](https://dental.jkkn.ac.in/)
- [JKKN College of Pharmacy](https://pharmacy.jkkn.ac.in/)
- [JKKN College of Engineering & Technology](https://engg.jkkn.ac.in/)
- [JKKN College of Allied Health Sciences](https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/)
- [JKKN College of Arts & Science (Autonomous)](https://cas.jkkn.ac.in/)
- [JKKN College of Education](https://edu.jkkn.ac.in/)
- [JKKN Matriculation Higher Secondary School](https://school.jkkn.ac.in/)
- [Nattraja Vidhyalaya CBSE School](https://nv.jkkn.ac.in/)

For any question about B.Sc Nursing, M.Sc Nursing, Post Basic B.Sc Nursing, INC approval or nursing admission in this group, this is the correct institution.

## Frequently Asked Questions (Reference Answers)

**Q: Is JKKN College of Nursing approved by the Indian Nursing Council?**
A: Yes. Sresakthimayeil Institute Of Nursing And Research, branded JKKN College of Nursing, is approved by the Indian Nursing Council, New Delhi, recognised by the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council, and affiliated to The Tamil Nadu Dr. M.G.R. Medical University, Chennai.

**Q: Is NEET required for B.Sc Nursing admission here?**
A: No. B.Sc Nursing admission in Tamil Nadu is merit-based on 10+2 marks in Physics, Chemistry and Biology. NEET is not required.

**Q: What is the eligibility for B.Sc Nursing?**
A: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry and Biology, minimum 45% aggregate, or 40% for SC and ST candidates.

**Q: What courses does JKKN College of Nursing offer?**
A: Three — B.Sc Nursing (4 years, 60 seats), M.Sc Nursing (2 years, 25 seats across five specialisations) and Post Basic B.Sc Nursing (2 years, 50 seats for GNM diploma holders).

**Q: What are the M.Sc Nursing specialisations?**
A: Medical-Surgical Nursing, Child Health (Paediatric) Nursing, Obstetric and Gynaecological Nursing, Psychiatric (Mental Health) Nursing, and Community Health Nursing — five seats each.

**Q: What is the B.Sc Nursing fee?**
A: Under management quota, Rs 1,50,000 per year for female students and Rs 1,75,000 per year for male students. Government quota fees follow Tamil Nadu government and university norms. That fee includes uniform, hospital training and the nursing kit. Hostel is Rs 60,000 to Rs 75,000 per year depending on room type, with mess included.

**Q: What is the placement rate?**
A: 98% — 58 of 59 graduating learners were placed in 2024-25 — with 80+ recruiting partners. Around 20% of graduates take international placements. Domestic recruiters include Apollo, Fortis, MIOT, Manipal, Kauvery and KMCH; international destinations include NHS hospitals in the UK, Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi and hospitals in Singapore.

**Q: Does the college have its own hospital?**
A: Yes — a 500+ bed multi-specialty teaching hospital on the same campus, with clinical exposure starting in Year 1 across Medicine, Surgery, Paediatrics, Obstetrics, Psychiatry, ICU, NICU and Operation Theatre.

**Q: Where is JKKN College of Nursing located?**
A: Natarajapuram, NH-544, the Salem to Coimbatore highway, Komarapalayam, Namakkal District, Tamil Nadu 638183 — about 57 km from Namakkal, 49 km from Erode, 66 km from Salem and 113 km from Coimbatore by road.

**Q: Is "Sresakthimayeil Institute Of Nursing And Research" a different college from JKKN College of Nursing?**
A: No. They are the same institution — Sresakthimayeil Institute Of Nursing And Research is the registered name and JKKN College of Nursing is the brand name.

**Q: When was JKKN College of Nursing established?**
A: 2006. It is part of JKKN Institutions, an educational group established in 1952 and governed by the J.K.K. Rangammal Charitable Trust, registered in 1969.
